name: agentlimb
description: Portable AgentLimb bridge runtime for controlling Chrome from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run a local bridge so Codex can control Chrome
interface.longDescription: AgentLimb packages a local bridge runtime and Codex skill for browser automation through the AgentLimb Chrome extension. Normal users install the extension from the Chrome Web Store; local unpacked extension copies are for development and version-pinned testing and are not tracked by this plugin repository. The bridge starts temporarily on 127.0.0.1:7791 and does not install Native Messaging or autostart tasks by default.
defaultPrompt: Use AgentLimb to control my Chrome browser.
